codeSystems.name: FijiAdminZonesVS
codeSystems.title: Health Administrative Zones Value Set
codeSystems.description: Valueset of Health administrative zones in Fiji

codeSystems.name: FijiAllergyAgentVS
codeSystems.title: Allergy Causative Agent Value Set
codeSystems.description: A subset of SNOMED CT concepts representing substances or products that cause allergies or intolerances.

codeSystems.name: FijiBodyPositionVS
codeSystems.title: Body Position Value Set
codeSystems.description: SELECT SNOMED CT code system values the position in which the individual was in during a measurement.

codeSystems.name: FijiBodySiteVS
codeSystems.title: Body Site Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for bodysite/anatomical structures.
Used for Condition.bodySite and Immunization.site
Values from SNOMED CT anatomical structures.

codeSystems.name: FijiConditionCodeVS
codeSystems.title: Condition (Diagnosis) Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. 
Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".

codeSystems.name: FijiDCMModalityVS
codeSystems.title: Dicom Modality Value Set
codeSystems.description: Imaging acquisition modalities based on DICOM CID 29.

codeSystems.name: FijiEncounterReasonVS
codeSystems.title: Encounter Reason Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Encounter reason valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED descendant of clinical findings and Procedures.

codeSystems.name: FijiEthnicityVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Patient Ethnicity Value Set
codeSystems.description: Valueset of Patient Ethnicity in Fiji

codeSystems.name: FijiEvidenceVS
codeSystems.title: Condition Evidence Value Set
codeSystems.description: Evidence: Signs, symptoms, procedures, and labs, explicitly excluding formal diseases.

codeSystems.name: FijiImagingReportVS
codeSystems.title: Imaging Report Value Set
codeSystems.description: Fiji imaging report including SNOMED CT concepts for radiology report and imaging report

codeSystems.name: FijiKorodinaVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Korodina Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The set of korodina codes recognised by the
Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: FijiMataqaliVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Mataqali Value Set
codeSystems.description: Mataqali codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: FijiMedVS
codeSystems.title: Medication Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Fiji Medication valueset including support for legacy codes derived from Fiji MSupply instance.
Provisionally SNOMED CT medication refset and ATC codes have also been added.

codeSystems.name: FijiMedicationRequestReasonVS
codeSystems.title: Medication Request Reason Value Set
codeSystems.description:
MedicationRequest reason valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED Problem/Diagnosis refsets.

codeSystems.name: FijiMedicationRouteVS
codeSystems.title: Medication or Vaccine Route Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for medication and vaccine route.
Used for Medications and Immunization.route
Values are descendants from SNOMED CT Route of Administration concept.

codeSystems.name: FijiObsInterpretationVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Observation Interpretation Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for interpretations of Observations for Fiji.
Used for interpretaton element for Observations and derived profiles (eg. Vital signs)
Values from  HL7 v3 Code System ObservationInterpretation with added values from WHO/Fiji usage.

codeSystems.name: FijiOccupationVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Patient Occupation Value Set
codeSystems.description: Valueset of Patient Occupation in Fiji

codeSystems.name: FijiOrganizationRoleVS
codeSystems.title: Organization Role Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for Healthcare Organization Role Type.
Values from SNOMED CT Hospital environment, Site of care, Outpatient environment, and Inpatient environment.

codeSystems.name: FijiRadiologyFindingsVS
codeSystems.title: Radiology Findings Value Set
codeSystems.description: Fiji radiology findings including SNOMED CT concepts filtered for radiology and imaging findings used within an IPS context.

codeSystems.name: FijiServiceTypeVS
codeSystems.title: Service Type Valueset
codeSystems.description:
Service Type valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED Services codes.

codeSystems.name: FijiTikinaVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Tikina Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The set of tikina codes recognised by the
Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: FijiTokatokaVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Tokatoka Value Set
codeSystems.description: Tokatoka codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: FijiVitalBodyWeightVS
codeSystems.title: Body Weight Vital Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Concepts representing options that provide further context for body weight coding. (eg.  Birth Weight...)
NOTE: This is not currently used but may be used in future when a full valueset has been developed

codeSystems.name: FijiVitalMethodVS
codeSystems.title: Vital Measurement Method Value Set
codeSystems.description:
SNOMED CT concepts representing methods used to obtain vital sign
measurements, including body temperature, blood pressure, body height,
body weight, heart rate, oxygen saturation and respiratory rate.
This may be extended as required including with local codes used in historic data.

codeSystems.name: FijiYasanaVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Yasana Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The set of yasana codes recognised by the
Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: FijiYavusaVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Yavusa Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The set of yavusa codes recognised by the
Fiji Implementation Guide.

codeSystems.name: HeartRateVS
codeSystems.title: Heart Rate LOINC Codes
codeSystems.description: LOINC codes for heart rate measurements, spot or average.

codeSystems.name: ImmVS
codeSystems.title: Immunization Value Set
codeSystems.description: Immunization valueset based on until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed

codeSystems.name: ImmStatusReasonVS
codeSystems.title: Immunization Status Reason Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Status Reason codes for reason a vaccine was not administered. 
Initial codes used are ICD-11 codes from DAK.
